summary: A glass app bar with a menu button in the leading slot and an Upgrade button plus avatar in the trailing slot.
use: Mobile or dashboard headers that need a menu toggle on the left and a primary call to action on the right.
spec: `<Card material="glass" full flush>` wraps the bar
`{#snippet leading()}` holds `<IconButton aria-label="Open menu">` with `<Menu size={20} />`
Trailing also has `<Avatar alt="Carlos M" size="sm" />`
